input.prompt: One single continuous cinematic shot with no cuts, filmed on a smooth steady gimbal at a slow, constant walking pace, like a scene from a film. Warm golden evening light, cozy European bistro. The shot starts outside on the street, looking through the restaurant's wooden-framed window at the poster on the wall inside. The camera glides smoothly to the left along the facade, reaches the open entrance door and moves forward through the doorway into the restaurant, ending just inside the door with the brass door handle in the left foreground and the dining room and poster ahead. The framed red pop-art poster of a hand holding a sparkling wine glass with the caption 'NO SPARKLING WINE, NO LIFE.' is a real flat printed poster: its illustration, lettering, white border and gold frame stay perfectly rigid and never warp, morph, redraw or change. Avoid: cuts, scene changes, morphing objects, warped poster, changing letters, garbled text, new text, extra posters, people, hands, birds, steam, smoke, shaking camera, fast movement, zoom jumps.
